data.one_liner: Create an elastic stretchy header effect when scrolling down a widget in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to easily add an elastic, stretchy header to scrollable widgets like ListViews or SingleChildScrollView. The header stretches dynamically when the user scrolls down, and supports overlays, blur effects, highlights, and refresh callbacks.
use_when: You want a profile or detail screen with a stretchy banner image at the top.
You need a custom header that responds elastically to scrolling gestures.
avoid_when: You require standard non-stretching app bars or SliverAppBar behaviors.
strengths: Supports multiple builders like list views and single child layouts.
Includes customizable features like blur, overlays, and highlight alignments.
weaknesses: May require adapting existing custom scroll physics if mixed with other sliver setups.
